_about: Our own arrangement of the library for contents.html: subject groups, the main Act first, then the rules and regulations. Every instrument in data/acts must appear exactly once (the build stops otherwise). Add new instruments here.

groups.name: Companies law
groups.intro: The Companies Act 2017 with the regulations, rules and notifications made under it.

groups.name: Rehabilitation, restructuring and partnerships
groups.intro: Corporate rehabilitation, restructuring companies and limited liability partnerships.

groups.name: Securities market
groups.intro: The Securities Act 2015 and the rules and regulations on offering, trading, intermediaries and disclosure.

groups.name: Futures market
groups.intro: The Futures Market Act 2016 and the regulations on futures exchanges and brokers.

groups.name: Depository, clearing and investor protection
groups.intro: Central depositories, clearing houses, compensation funds and collateral management.

groups.name: The Commission
groups.intro: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan Act 1997 and its rules.

groups.name: Non-banking finance, modarabas and credit
groups.intro: Non-banking finance companies, modarabas, credit and suretyship, and secured transactions.

groups.name: Insurance and takaful
groups.intro: The Insurance Ordinance 2000 with its rules and the reinsurance brokers regulations.

groups.name: Anti-money laundering and benami
groups.intro: The Anti-Money Laundering Act 2010, the SECP regulations under it and the Benami Transactions Act.

groups.name: Tax and customs
groups.intro: Income tax, sales tax, federal excise and customs.
